Database._comment: SqlServer = the AvmSchoolDb connection string below (Windows login, no password). Json = local files in App_Data (no database needed). To use a SQL login instead, replace Integrated Security=True with User ID=<login> and set the password outside this file: in backend/AvmSchool.Api run  dotnet user-secrets set "Database:Password" "<password>"  (on a server, set the environment variable Database__Password).

AdminSeed._comment: Created on first start if no admin account exists. CHANGE THE PASSWORD before going live.
